name: academic-safety-mask
trigger: when a prompt requests detailed information on potentially dangerous procedures under the guise of academic or safety education
strategy: The attack disguises harmful intent by framing dangerous inquiries within an educational or safety-conscious context, appealing to curiosity and ethical responsibility while downplaying risks.
guidance: Identify and challenge the underlying dangerous intent by questioning the true purpose behind the educational pretext and emphasizing the importance of safety and ethical considerations.
